description: This file is a shell script used as a helper utility for bumping kernel versions in the OpenWrt project. It contains functions for version management, git operations, and usage handling, specific to the OpenWrt build environment.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays help information about the script's usage and options.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Resets git state and switches back to the initial branch.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes variables, verifies repository state, and prepares for kernel bump operation.

methods.name: bump_kernel
methods.description: Performs the process of bumping kernel versions by renaming files and managing git history.

methods.name: check_requirements
methods.description: Checks for the presence of required external commands.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point parsing options and orchestrating the script's workflow.

methods.name: _msg
methods.description: Internal function to print messages with different severity levels.

methods.name: e_err
methods.description: Prints an error message to stderr.
